mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 70 degrees at Verona Community Park under a Waning Gibbous moon. Early risers can see the space station pass overhead at 4:14 AM, appearing near Verona High School before heading toward the Madison area. Expect an overnight low of 68 degrees with some rain showers predicted.

Mayor Diaz has issued several proclamations for September, including Hunger Action Month to fight food insecurity and Suicide Prevention Month to promote mental health resources. Additionally, please be aware that flagging on Highway M for utility work will cause delays through early next week.

Today you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Verona Area Kids Triathlon takes place at the high school alongside a Girls Try Hockey event at the arena.
On August 19, Verona police responded to a motor vehicle crash with minor injuries at North Main Street and Bering Drive, where two drivers were cited for traffic violations.
Today's flavor is the refreshing Mint Explosion. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 23 minutes, so stop by quickly if you want a treat tonight.
